text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud! Thud-thud!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: De-fense! De-fense!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Alright, time to strike back!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Yay, a free throw! Go, let's go♪ Go, let's 
go♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes! We did it, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Now we can turn the tables!
Yeah! This turns the tables!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi has a professional basketball 
team. —New Year's. Everyone went to watch 
the game and cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us visited the local 
shrine for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year—the Senior division. 
This is the year—we "topple the Central".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We must achieve complete victory over both 
the older and younger generations to prove 
the might of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I felt the same way. Today, the 
Funabashi basketball team scored a 
resounding victory, but...
choice_data_list:
I wanna do my best so we don't lose to the 
basketball team

Let's do our best so we don't lose to the 
basketball team!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The basketball team in Funabashi 
is among the best in the nation.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What overwhelming strength again today. 
The final stretch was practically "garbage 
time."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Right... Speaking of garbage time...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I thought about this back during 
the Diolite Kinen, too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
“It's practically garbage time, so did she 
really need to blow them out by that 
much?” they're asking.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... The outcome was already clear, 
after all.

Yeah... The outcome was already obvious, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Garbage time." That is— an unwritten rule 
of basketball.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When a massive gap opened up and the 
outcome became obvious, the winning side 
was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flashy plays that insult the opponent, 
such as dunk shots, are strictly 
prohibited.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It is proper etiquette not to kick 
someone while they're down. So I 
wondered... why would she do that!?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
But the reason Crimson Nova showed no 
mercy until the very end was...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It might not have been out of arrogance, 
but due to entirely different 
circumstances."
choice_data_list: Different circumstances...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A "sense of responsibility" where 
losing isn't an option under any 
circumstance. They were desperate, too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If that's what led to that overkill... I 
have mixed feelings about it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The strong, arrogant Central. Because 
that's what I thought of them, I was able 
to fuel my hostility, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I sense what the other side is 
feeling, my fighting spirit inevitably 
wavers. Furthermore...
choice_data_list:
All the top runners from the younger 
generation are people we know, huh?

All the top runners from the younger 
generation are people we know, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The one who's rapidly growing 
stronger right now is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Furioso. Just 'cause you're done 
racin' Crimson Nova, don't go gettin' 
cocky!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year, ya gotta deal with me! 
I'm gonna put you through hell!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let me join, let me join! I've been doing 
super well in both races and concerts 
lately!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can show off lots of sparkly 
things! To Furioso-san, and to all my 
fans♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, Falcon-san... Plus the 
well-informed Transcend-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
These three are building up strength at a 
terrifying pace...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to lose. I absolutely 
cannot lose. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... it's hard to deal with... 
They're the girls I'm always with, so 
why...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand the anguish well. Furioso 
isn't combative by nature at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, she is forcing herself to feel 
hatred purely for the sake of her goal. 
Her true feelings are falling behind...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However—even so—I cannot simply retract 
the goal I've set.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat the JRA. Unless we achieve this, 
Funabashi will never be rewarded. It just 
won't."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'll beat them... I will beat them... 
Falcon-san, and Espo-san too."
choice_data_list: Furioso...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She cannot lower her fists now. However, 
Furioso still carries this contradiction 
within her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can they fight? Can they maintain that 
state of mind?
choice_data_list:
For now, try not to brood over it too 
much.

For now, try not to brood over it too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That's true... I'll try to 
relax as much as possible...
choice_data_list:
Why don't you make a little wish or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso is always so serious. Every once 
in a while, it's fine to casually pray to 
the gods for help.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: A modest wish... Well then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Furioso made a wish, and told me 
what she wished for.
choice_data_list: I want to eat some delicious soba
I want to see Dad
I wanna go skiing

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I want to eat... some delicious soba.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's make that wish come true.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, the Trainer is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tapping away on my smartphone, I search 
for a delicious soba shop. The shop I 
arrived at is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Here it is. Soba Restaurant "Brian". I 
feel like I've heard that name somewhere 
before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-clatter)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm rather particular about my soba, but 
the noodles here are――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's ridiculously good.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san? Wait, is this shop owned 
by a relative of yours?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No, their names just happen to be similar. 
There are other... regulars.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya just figured out why the soba here 
tastes so good!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be they use great ingredients? 
Or maybe it's because the water is high 
quality?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, shopkeeper! Could it be you seek 
an uprising in the soba world with these 
noodles!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
So many Umamusume... Is the flavor truly 
that captivating? I shall try it as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slurp, slurrrp)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious...! This rustic, earthy 
flavor is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso recharged her energy by enjoying a 
bowl of soba that's wildly popular with 
certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to see Dad. I can see him at home, 
of course, but every now and then, I'd 
like to see him while he's at work.
choice_data_list: Then, want to try visiting the workplace?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Since we have the chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the place we arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Furioso. What's up? Coming all the way 
out here when it's not even a race day.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Dad, how's work going?

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this Funabashi Racecourse has also 
come quite far with its digital 
transformation.

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Father
text_block_list.text:
I need to train the staff thoroughly so we 
don't get left behind by the times.

text_block_list.name: Furioso's Father
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, you're still around 
here for the New Year, right? Want to come 
over for dinner tonight too?
choice_data_list: Y-Yes, if it wouldn't be a bother...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Dad... aren't you calling for me way too 
much, day after day?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's father is a kind man. 
Experiencing his warm personality made my 
heart feel a little bigger.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to go... skiing. I want to glide... 
over the powder snow...
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we get going then?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, you'll take me with you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Heh...! Haah...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much! Skiing 
really is the best, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind in a straight 
descent feels truly amazing.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm glad you're having fun!
Yeah, I'm glad you're enjoying it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso seemed overjoyed to have come 
skiing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my dad mentioned it 
before. Apparently, people used to be able 
to ski in Funabashi back in the day.
choice_data_list: Is that so? How did you manage that?
Really? How?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, there used to be a massive 
indoor ski slope. So people could go 
skiing even on their way home from school 
or work."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I'm a little... envious, to be honest.
choice_data_list: Yeah...
That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on old Funabashi, from an era 
we never knew...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, since we came all this way, let's 
skate a whole lot more!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we enjoyed skiing to our 
heart's content and learned various ways 
to use our bodies.
